values.note: recreation.gov rate table, Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30 (and the same for 2027): standard electric sites $22 a night; the table also lists a $26 variant of the standard-electric rate without saying which sites it covers. Group pavilion $60.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233604/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01..2026-09-30 and 2027-05-01..2027-09-30: 'STANDARD ELECTRIC': 22, a coded STANDARD ELECTRIC variant 26, 'SHELTER ELECTRIC': 60), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233604 ('The electric sites offer up to 50 AMP service') + RIDB catalog (59 sites list Electricity Hookup 15/30/50; every campsite is typed STANDARD ELECTRIC), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 68 standard electric campsites in the catalog (64 reservable, 4 not: 007, 020, 046, 051) plus a reservable group pavilion. Every site is back-in; the catalog gives no vehicle lengths. Two camping units per site, the second a tent.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233604 (68 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, Driveway Entry Back-In on all, Max Vehicle Length 0) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233604 (notice 'Two camping units are permitted at each site, with the second one being a tent'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Shower house and full bathroom in the front loop, a bathroom without showers in the back loop; water fill-up station near the entrance station; dump station. Campground store; stocked Kalbaugh Pond behind it.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233604 ('There is a shower house and full bathroom located in the front loop of the campground, as well as a bathroom with no showers located at the back loop'; 'a water fill-up station located near the entrance station'; 'there is also a dump station available'; 'Located behind the Campground Store, the Kalbaugh Pond'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov rules: 3-night minimum on holiday weekends (no weekend minimum); no more than 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Four of the 68 campsites are not reservable online. No drive-throughs of the campground on holiday weekends.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233604 (facility_rules minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 per Rolling 30 Days; notice 'No campground drive-throughs on holiday weekends') + RIDB catalog (64 of 68 campsites reservable), read 2026-10-21

summary: rec.gov page, rates and catalog: fees $22 confirmed (a $26 standard-electric variant noted); 50-amp confirmed (was derived); added 68 back-in electric sites, showers/flush toilets/water fill/dump, 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max. Season not stated (rate seasons only); water/sewer at the site not stated. Run by the Corps (Baltimore District). Note kept (AWH firsthand).
